name: Docker hosts
description: Shows your Docker hosts with their containers: state, health, restarts, image (and how old it is), compose project, published ports, and containers with their own address on your network (macvlan / ipvlan) matched to the devices Netlens found. Optionally flags containers that have a newer image in their registry. Read-only, through a read-only socket proxy (the README has the recipe). Tested on Docker 29.8.2 with a bridge-network setup; macvlan and ipvlan are tested with simulated data only.
author: Netlens
supports: Containers on macvlan / ipvlan networks (not yet tested on a real host)

releases.changelog: New setting Check for newer images (off by default): Netlens asks the registry each image comes from whether its tag now points to a newer image and flags those containers, with an event. Only image names are sent. Needs IMAGES: 1 on the socket proxy and Netlens 0.3.119 or newer.
The settings page has a collapsed box with the docker-compose lines for the read-only socket proxy that every Docker host needs, with a Copy button. Needs Netlens 0.3.115 or newer.

Hosts are entered as a list: one line per Docker host (proxy address, and the host's own address under More), a Test button per line, and Test all. Existing settings carry over. Needs Netlens 0.3.109 or newer.

First release. Docker hosts and their containers as guests of the host: state, health, restarts, image and its age, compose project, published ports, and macvlan / ipvlan containers matched to devices. Needs Netlens 0.2.106 or newer.
